text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A after a large gain may have felt like locking in success, but it does not show that I can time future prices; I should base sales on portfolio needs and a consistent plan.","My account fell after a strong run, reminding me that gains can reverse; I should check that my overall risk and cash level suit my goals rather than rely on recent performance.","At 59, I should consider when I may need the money and avoid taking more risk than I can tolerate, while still making decisions from the portfolio as a whole."]}
